title: Magnificent Mountainside Estate with Ultimate Priv
description:
Welcome to Scottsdale’s most exclusive vacation rental residence. Nestled on five acres, this estate has mountain views from every room. 8,500 sq. ft with eight bedrooms, nine bathrooms, two living rooms, a game room, five work stations, two roof top decks and luscious outdoor spaces. Top it off by adding on one of our many concierge services available - Private chef, massage therapists, or pre-made meals to easily heat and serve at your leisure.

 The space 
Amenities List:
-Large heated pool and hot tub (Pool heating cost is $250 per night with a 3 night consecutive minimum).
-Game room with ping pong table, arcade game console, foosball table, Media set with Play Station 5, and a spacious walk out deck.
-Fully equipped gym with dumbbells (up to 65 lbs.), weight bench, cable pulleys, kettle bells, TRX, medicine balls, punching bag, Peloton bike, treadmill, and a massage table.
-Large open grass area great for sports games and children`s playground equipment.
-Multiple outdoor patios with sitting areas, outdoor fire-pits, BBQ grill, sun loungers, and a half court basketball space.
-Dog Friendly: Up to 2 dogs allowed at VacayAZ`s discretion with a pet fee of $350 and a refundable deposit of $1,000. Occupants are responsible for any and all damages resulting from pets beyond deposit amount. 

Indoor Spaces:
-Spacious chefs kitchen with induction cook top, huge walk in pantry, double wall ovens, warming drawer, food steamer, coffee station, and connected outdoor bar seating.
-Open family room wall TV, dining room space, and floor to ceiling sliding doors that access a private patio with outdoor fireplace nestled against the mountain side.
-Secondary living room with a wall TV and 2 desk spaces - A great room for the kids to hang out in.
-Four car garage - plenty of room for vehicle parking.
-Large laundry room

Bedroom Layout:
King Suite: The true master bedroom. King size bed with quality BeutyRest Black Hybrid mattress complimented by an indoor fireplace. Attached bathroom includes breathe-taking mountain views from both the large soaking tub and spacious walk-in shower. Full gym is also accessible from the master with all the necessary equipment.
Queen Suite: The second of three master bedrooms. King size bed with a computer desk for remote working. En-suite full bathroom. Private access to the exterior space.
Bishop Suite: The third master bedroom. King size bed and comfortable reading chair. En-suite bathroom with full walk-in shower. Exterior access with private patio space.
Rook Suite #1: King sized bed. Computer desk for remote working. En-suite bathroom with walk-in shower.
Rook Suite #2: King sized bed. En-suite bathroom with Shower/Tub combo.
Knight Suite #1: King sized bed. Floor to ceiling glass with incredible mountain views. En-suite bathroom with walk-in shower.
Knight Suite #2: King sized bed. Floor to ceiling glass with incredible mountain views. En-suite bathroom with walk-in shower.
Pawn Suite: Two Queen beds. Interior gas fireplace. Work space for remote working. Private exterior access.

*Please be aware that due to over-seeding, the grass area is not usable in early October. We do this to ensure the grass is as nice and healthy as it can be.*

VacayAZ enforces good neighbor policies on all managed properties. Renting homes in a neighborhood/community is a privilege and must be treated as such. Guests must be mindful of their noise levels at all times and respect the rules of the community. We do not provide speakers and/or sound systems on-site.

Smoking is not allowed in this property. Cigar smoking is permitted - OUTDOOR ONLY. Violating this policy will result in forfeiture of the full security deposit and guests will be liable for the full cost of damage resulting from it.
